uiSetup.adaptiveInfoUC: Adaptive Difficulty: The more Imperial groups you manage to defeat, the harder the Empire tries to stop you, but the better your rewards.

uiMainApp.eliteUpgradeMsgUC: One or more <color="green">Regular</color> Deployments have been upgraded to an <color="red">Elite</color> Group.
uiMainApp.eliteDowngradeMsgUC: One or more <color="red">Elite</color> Deployments have been downgraded to a <color="green">Regular</color> Group.
uiMainApp.fame1UC:
If you finish the mission before the end of Round 7, you can claim the number of Awards shown.

After the mission, Awards can be used to:
uiMainApp.fameItem1UC: • Draw an additional Item card from an Item deck of your choice during the Rebel Upgrade stage (cost: 1 Award per card).
uiMainApp.fameItem2UC: • Draw an additional Side Mission card and put it into play as an active mission (cost: 2 Awards per card, maximum 2 cards).
uiMainApp.fame2UC: Once the round counter reaches 8, Mission Awards are set to 0.

uiMainApp.deploymentWarningUC: There are either no Enemy Groups to deploy, or the current Threat is too low to deploy any Groups.

sagaMainApp.medpacInfoUC:
A hero can use a Medpac when they perform a Rest Action, and an Ally figure can use a Medpac as an Action.

When a figure uses a Medpac, it recovers 5 {H}. Medpacs can be found in Crates.

uiCampaign.threatInfoUC: Threat level is equal to the most recently played mission.
uiCampaign.campaignDescriptionUC: Embark on a new or existing Campaign through the galaxy.
uiCampaign.sagaDescriptionUC: Play a single, narratively driven mission with a 3D map presentation.
uiCampaign.classicDescriptionUC: Play a single mission using your campaign guide and no 3D map.
uiCampaign.agendaImperialUC: The Empire sees you as a threat worth stopping. Draw a card from the Imperial Mission Deck and put it into play. If it is a forced mission, immediately play that mission. If it is a side mission, it becomes an active side mission.
uiCampaign.agendaRebelUC: The Empire uses its resources elsewhere. Nothing happens.

uiTacticalAI.docGuard: Guard (hold the zone, never be lured out)
uiTacticalAI.docAmbusher: Ambush (stay unseen until the first shot)
uiTacticalAI.moveFocus:
Focus target within attack range and clear line of sight? Then: attack the focus target.
Line of sight to the focus target blocked by a hero figure? Then: attack that blocking figure.
Focus target out of range? Then: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus target - until the figure is within attack range.
uiTacticalAI.moveFocusNoTarget:
A hero within attack range and clear line of sight? Then: attack him.
No hero reachable? Then: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero - until the figure is within attack range.
uiTacticalAI.moveGuard:
Your movement always ends inside your guard zone (the mission objective you defend, plus its rim).
A hero enters the guard zone? Then: move against him. No hero in the zone? Then: hold your position. Never let yourself be lured out.
uiTacticalAI.moveBlocker:
Occupy the space between the mission objective and the nearest hero's path - his shortest route to the objective should cross your tile.
No such space reachable? Then: hold the next chokepoint on his route.
uiTacticalAI.moveSupport:
Keep your distance from the focus target.
Approach by at most {0} spaces - and only if no hero would then stand within melee reach of you. Otherwise: hold the distance.
uiTacticalAI.moveAmbusher:
Move only onto spaces no hero can see.
A target within your attack range? Then: reveal and attack. No target in range? Then: stay undetected.
uiTacticalAI.attackFocus:
Not attacked yet? Then: attack the focus target - weapon/ability range and clear line of sight required.
No line of sight or too far? Then: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus target.
Line of sight blocked by ANOTHER hero figure? Then: attack that blocking figure.
Already attacked? Then no second attack - unless the Imperial card explicitly allows multiple attacks; then proceed like Action 1.
Instead: Movement points left? Then spend them in cover.
uiTacticalAI.attackNoTarget:
Not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero you can reach (range + clear line of sight).
No hero reachable? Then: move up to {0} spaces toward the nearest hero.
Already attacked? Then: spend leftover movement in cover.
uiTacticalAI.attackGuard:
Not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero inside your guard zone (range + clear line of sight).
No hero in the guard zone, but the focus target is shootable from here? Then: attack the focus target.
Already attacked or no target? Then: no shot - move up to {0} spaces against the nearest hero INSIDE your guard zone or hold your position.
uiTacticalAI.attackGuardNoTarget:
Not attacked yet? Then: the nearest hero inside your guard zone (range + clear line of sight).
No hero in the zone or already attacked? Then: no shot - move up to {0} spaces against the nearest hero INSIDE your guard zone or hold your position.
uiTacticalAI.attackAmbush:
Not attacked yet? Then: the ambush shot at the first hero you can shoot from here (range + clear line of sight) - surprise beats target choice, even over the focus target.
Afterwards: do not unmask further.
Already attacked? Then: stay unseen - relocate to a space no hero can see (up to {0}); your next shot comes from new cover.
uiTacticalAI.attackAmbushNoTarget:
Not attacked yet? Then: the ambush shot at the first hero you can shoot from here (range + clear line of sight).
Afterwards: do not unmask further.
Already attacked? Then: stay unseen - relocate to a space no hero can see (up to {0}); your next shot comes from new cover.
uiTacticalAI.attackSupport:
Not attacked yet? Then: attack the focus target (range + clear line of sight) - from cover, prefer soft targets.
No line of sight or too far? Then: back off instead of pushing in.
Line of sight blocked by ANOTHER hero figure? Then: attack that blocking figure.
Already attacked? Then: stay in cover and spend leftover movement falling back.
uiTacticalAI.attackSupportNoTarget:
Not attacked yet? Then: the softest target you can shoot from cover (range + clear line of sight).
No target? Then: back off.
Already attacked? Then: stay in cover.
uiTacticalAI.attack2Move: Focus target still within your attack range? Then: hold cover and pre-aim for the next activation. Otherwise: move up to {0} spaces toward the focus target.
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveNoTarget: Hold cover against the nearest hero - or move up to {0} spaces toward him.
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveGuard: Move up to {0} spaces against the nearest hero inside your guard zone - or hold your position.
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveAmbush: Relocate to a space no hero can see (up to {0}) - your next shot comes from new cover.
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveBlocker: Pick a new blocking space between the mission objective and the focus target (up to {0} spaces). No focus target? Then: hold the chokepoint against the nearest hero.
uiTacticalAI.attackSecondIntro:
Already attacked this activation? Then this block is a move: {0}
A second attack is forbidden - unless the Imperial card explicitly allows multiple attacks; then proceed like the first attack.
uiTacticalAI.attackSecondTail: Not attacked yet? Then this block counts as the first attack: shoot if possible; otherwise close in; shoot figures blocking the line of sight.
uiTacticalAI.assaultSecondAttack: The special printed on your card allows multiple attacks: if you already attacked this activation, this block IS your second attack - proceed exactly like the first attack. Not attacked yet? Then this block is your first attack.
uiTacticalAI.moveGuardTripod:
Tripod: moving and attacking are mutually exclusive in one activation – leaving your space means no shot.
Nothing guarded and no target in reach? Then: move onto a position from which you sweep the rebels' route.
Post held or target in reach? Then: stay on your space.
uiTacticalAI.attackGuardTripod:
Not attacked yet? Then: the next hero in your reach (range + clear line of sight).
No target in reach, but the focus target is shootable from your space? Then: attack the focus target.
No shot possible? Then: stay on your space – no movement, moving would forfeit your attack.
uiTacticalAI.attackGuardTripodNoTarget:
Not attacked yet? Then: the next hero in your reach (range + clear line of sight).
No target in reach? Then: stay on your space – no movement, moving would forfeit your next attack.
uiTacticalAI.attack2MoveGuardTripod: stay on your space – any movement would forfeit your next attack
uiTacticalAI.overlordFallback: Tactical AI - Overlord: tactical world feed not active yet - planning follows the Reference rules.
uiTacticalAI.specialAsPrinted: Special action: execute exactly as printed on the card.
uiTacticalAI.restLine: Leave this action unperformed: Imperial figures have no Endurance value, so resting would gain them nothing. The figure stays put.
uiTacticalAI.interactLine: Interact: perform an interaction the mission allows (e.g. open an adjacent door, unless the mission has locked it).
uiTacticalAI.focusWounded: he is wounded - finish him first (table damage tracker)
uiTacticalAI.focusFirepower: highest firepower among the remaining heroes (attack dice, then health)
uiTacticalAI.ordAbilitiesLane: Printed special abilities are the Imperium player's call: the attack action may include them exactly as printed (Rules Reference) - the Tactical AI proposes movement and attack only, because deciding 'may' abilities needs the board it never sees.
uiTacticalAI.ordFocusDetail: Focus score: {0} = {1} ({2}); basis: {3}; next: {4} — printed hero-card values, wound marks and the mission goal are the only inputs.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseShiftQM: Time runs out: the Imperium leaves its defensive posture and hunts — round {0} of {1} on the mission clock.
uiTacticalAI.ordPhaseExplain: Phase: {0} -> {1} (mission clock in its final third).
uiTacticalAI.ordThreat: threat {0} per round (printed hero card: values, weapon, items)
uiTacticalAI.ordStrainPressure: heroes with a full strain buffer are briefly a little more vulnerable
uiTacticalAI.ordMarked: aim marker: the mission objective names him
uiTacticalAI.ordInfoAttack: Attack: use a weapon or an ability.
uiTacticalAI.ordInfoDoor: Doors may be opened on the way to the objective - opening one costs an action (interact); locked doors only as the mission rules allow.
uiTacticalAI.ordInfoRule: Basic rule: an Imperial figure attacks only once per activation - unless its Imperial card explicitly allows several attacks. An unused action is lost; the figure simply stays put.
uiTacticalAI.personaRankUpQM: {0} takes command: the threat raises the rank from {1} to {2}.
uiTacticalAI.personaRankDownQM: {0} is demoted: the threat lowers the rank from {1} to {2}.
uiTacticalAI.personaCaptSignature: Troops cheaper, aggressive forward cover, one defensive line among ranged groups.
uiTacticalAI.personaIsbSignature: Rebel hunters (AT-ST) first, more stand-and-shoot at distance, defensive reserve only on order.
uiTacticalAI.personaHuttSignature: Bounty hunters and beasts first, costly groups keep distance and position.
uiTacticalAI.personaPlainNote: Follow default = no AI persona: the Imperium plays plain.
uiTacticalAI.personaCycleNote: Click the PERSONA button to choose (NONE = plain play).
